profile.headline: Software Engineer at Assembled | Ex Meta
profile.summary: Out of Bound and Null pointer exceptions were the start of my journey. Finding and resolving such errors in my code made me feel proud of myself. My computer Science journey has so far been learning from errors and mistakes, special thanks to Google and Stack Overflow. Computer science is a universe of possibilities and I want to dive deep inside this universe and explore ways that can make the lives of people easier. This is the primary reason why I want to expand my knowledge and contribute to this field of opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
AR Discovery Team – Meta
Exploring and Innovating in Augmented Reality (AR) Space

At Meta, I work with the AR Discovery Team, focused on developing and creating innovative AR experiences designed to be fun, interactive, and productive. My role involves working on the Orion prototype—Meta’s next-generation AR glasses—where I contribute to shaping Instagram’s interactive AR experience. These efforts are focused on creating immersive and seamless AR interactions that will enhance the future of Instagram on AR glasses.

Workflow and Code Automation – Meta AI

Additionally, I leverage Meta AI to improve and automate development workflows, optimizing coding practices across teams. This includes automating the generation of status reports based on developer tasks and code diffs, as well as integrating AI-driven solutions within VS Code to help developers efficiently address coding tasks. By automating these processes, we aim to save time, reduce errors, and empower developers with smarter tools to improve productivity.

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description:
•  Developing, designing and implementing testable and scalable code using IVR technology that allows humans to interact with computer-operated phone system through the use of voice and DTMF.

•   Analyzing, writing, updating, and maintaining computer programs and system components

•   Worked with known companies like Guardian Life and Bank of America to upgrade their current Voice assistant by making necessary changes.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Helping people make new connections, LinkMe allows you to share your selected social link at one click making the process of socialization fluent and faster. LinkMe uses Google Nearby to share the information with nearby users. Helps in brand awareness, marketing, and sharing information effectively between users.
•	Developed the application using Android Studio. Simple and user-friendly UI along with strong backend services provided by google firebase makes LinkMe reliable and complete. It also uses REST API and node.js for instant notification.

positions.title: Aresty Research Assistant program
positions.locationName: New Brunswick, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
•	Built a program that extracts data from Arduino sensors and represents it in the form of graphs using the help of plotting function in python.
•	The main aim is to reduce food corruption by constantly monitoring the food state. Integrate a small, low-cost device inside the vehicle that constantly monitors the food and sends an hourly report.

projects.title: Mask Detection System
projects.description: An OpenCV and tensor flow project that helps the user to detect real-time mask with more than 95% accuracy. This project was inspired from a previous project and with the help of a pre-trained model.

projects.title: IoT application
projects.description:
A real-time graph display based on the sensor on ventilator that allows the doctor to observe the real-time changes from his device.
Used Google real-time firebase to store and extract data with Graph.js to plot the data in form of graphs.
